turns.name: check_symptom

args.symptom: I had a tooth out yesterday and my cheek is swollen

turns.speech: Swelling on day 1 after a tooth extraction is within what we expect, so nothing is going wrong. Keep going with the aftercare. Call us on +20 2 2404 1180 if it changes direction and starts getting worse instead of better.

turns.name: check_symptom

args.symptom: I'm having trouble swallowing and my neck is swelling

turns.speech: That needs to be seen now, not tomorrow. Please call the emergency line on +20 100 555 0199 straight away, and if you are struggling to breathe or swallow, go to the nearest emergency department instead of waiting for a call back.
